title: Anagallis Arvensis
text: This remedy is characterized by its action on the skin and the mind. It is useful in cases of skin diseases and mental disturbances. There is a general feeling of irritation and burning. It is also useful in cases of enlarged glands and gout. Confused and forgetful. Loquacity. Irritable. Intense itching and burning. Eruptions like miliary rash. Eczema on the fingers and hands. Warts on the hands. Aching and lameness in the limbs. Gouty pains in the joints. Compare: Rhus toxicodendron; Anacardium; Selenium. Third to thirtieth potency.
